title: Rematch round 4, Skippy Core's coder: lost to Haiku's round 4 train (Haiku 4-0)
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8) as a vanilla agent (Claude Code with purple's system prompt, an empty setup, effort high, a 131K window) plus purple's generic help: eyes (Core's vision model describes the pictures it opens) and the stop gate's work check (MineBench's runtime as the checker, the renderer as the viewer, an 80K output-token budget)
verdict: Lost to Haiku's head-to-head round 4 train (blind judge, high confidence), which ends the rematch at 4-0. 31 minutes, 81 turns, shown its picture three times and nudged once on the budget. The judge: a black steam locomotive with a big white smoke plume, a brown cab and tender and one long red-and-yellow coach with a grey roof, on grass with trees; bold colours and it reads as a train, but the top view shows it lying east-west across a north-south track, at right angles to its rails, and there is only one car. Haiku's: a locomotive, tender and green coaches on their track by a station and a river.
